title: Orbbec FAE Partner Provider Release Evidence v1
description: Release evidence that a real Partner Provider passed the dev real-account probe. The Reference Provider can never satisfy this contract. The document carries booleans, one probe timestamp and one digest only; no partner sign-in material of any kind may appear here.

provider_kind.description: Registered Partner Provider kind. The Reference Provider is forbidden.

dev_real_account_tested_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the dev real-account probe. Never in the future, and inside the 180 day evidence freshness window.

evidence_sha256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 digest of the archived probe evidence bundle. The bundle itself is never stored in this repository.

$comment: Threshold booleans are const true so a partially verified Provider cannot be released: stable_subject_verified proves a stable non-reassignable subject; two_distinct_subjects_verified proves two real operators map to two subjects; active_status_or_local_revocation_verified proves status reporting or sufficient local revocation; shared_password_forbidden proves no shared sign-in path authenticates an operator; state_and_callback_replay_verified proves start-state binding and callback replay rejection.
